corrections_applied: See contracts/CHANGELOG.md and docs/pathways/DECISION_LOG.md DEC-C2, C4, C6, DEC-H2, DEC-H3+. Source pack version: 1.0.0-candidate (preserved verbatim at docs/pathways/pack/contracts/rules.json). RETIRED rules are kept in this array for explainability but must be skipped during evaluation by the Phase 4 engine; only rules without a status of RETIRED are evaluated. rules.retired_reason: Confirmed redundant with PAR_002 (DEC-C6, Phase 0 audit): PAR_002's condition (desired_parent_involvement = PROGRAM_MANAGES) is a strict superset of this rule's condition (the same, plus homeschool_interest = true), and both produce an identical score_effects ({B08: -3, B09: -2}) and identical review_model_scope ([B08, B09]). Every profile that triggers this rule also triggers PAR_002 with the same effect, so retiring this rule changes no score and removes no unique behavior -- confirmed by direct comparison of both rules' conditions and effects, not merely asserted. Kept in this array, not deleted, so historical engine runs that recorded this rule ID remain explainable. The Phase 4 engine must not evaluate a RETIRED rule.

rules.retired_reason: DEC-H2 (docs/pathways/DECISION_LOG.md): cost belongs to PRACTICAL FEASIBILITY, not EDUCATIONAL ALIGNMENT (DISCOVERY_CALIBRATION_SPEC_V2.md section 12) -- a family preferring tuition-free options is not evidence that a tuition-free base model is a better educational fit for their student, so this rule's direct score_effects on B02/B03/B04 is exactly the anti-pattern the architectural change forbids. Cost still reaches the report through REV_COST_ALIGNMENT (scoring-policy.json postprocess_rules / material_review_mapping), which surfaces cost as a discussion point rather than inflating a base model's score. No replacement rule: this concern is deliberately not re-implemented as a scoring rule.

review_signal_notes.REV_SERVICE_AVAILABILITY: Resolves DEC-C5 (Phase 0 audit) for the other previously-unwired review signal. Per owner instruction, this signal is NOT triggered by any rule in this file and must not be: whether Pathways advising/consultation is actually live for a family's stated location is an operational/service-configuration concern, resolved by the consultation adapter (Phase 6) outside the educational scoring function entirely. It affects the report's CTA and service-availability explanation, never educational fit or candidate scoring. An unconfigured service must never be presented as available; REQUEST_ONLY mode is permissible only when request-intake is actually authorized and configured.
